en: Black‑and‑white street view showing a cobblestone square with a large, ornate early‑20th‑century public building featuring tall windows, decorative panels, and a distinctive domed tower. In the foreground stands a small, simple building with a steep tiled roof. Vintage automobiles and a few pedestrians appear on the right side of the scene. The word "KOTKA" is handwritten at the bottom right of the image.
